rows.en: The neutral autonomous zone <pic(0)><cs(3)>Theart Star<ce()> is surrounded by <mk(0,-12.5,0,1)><ar(0,0,1,150)><mk(-62.5,-37.5,1,1,50)><ar(0,1,1,150)><mk(62.5,-37.5,7,1,150)><ar(0,7,1,150)>the Poseidal Army.
rows.speaker: ? (briefing officer)

rows.en: We need to get to the Gate of Zedan as soon as possible, but
rows.speaker: ? (briefing officer)

rows.en: since Theart Star has also been helping to protect space refugees,
rows.speaker: ? (briefing officer)

rows.en: Commander Misumaru has sent an urgent request for us to save it.
rows.speaker: ? (briefing officer)

rows.en: And we can't just stand by and let Poseidal's outrages go unchecked here, either.
rows.speaker: ? (briefing officer)

rows.en: <mk(62.5,37.5,7,0,50)><ar(0,7,0,50)>We will hurry to <pic(1)><cs(3)>the surrounding space<ce()> and eliminate the besieging enemy units.
rows.speaker: ? (briefing officer)

rows.en: Just as Full Flat told us, we have confirmed a Titans fleet.
rows.speaker: ? (briefing officer)

rows.en: We have to strike them before they reach the Gate of Zedan.
rows.speaker: ? (briefing officer)

rows.en: I've already sent the Peacemillion and Nadesico C. Please head there at once as well.
rows.speaker: ? (briefing officer)

rows.en: I'm worried about Miss Relena... We have to hurry.
rows.speaker: ? (briefing officer)

rows.en: To think that Londo Bell, a gathering of the elite, would actually be defeated...
